node.title: Re: Change create file date
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [artem78],

A quick search on CPAN reveals that [mod://Win32API::File::Time] may be able to help you. From its synopsis:

use Win32API::File::Time qw{:win}; ($atime, $mtime, $ctime) = GetFileTime ($filename); SetFileTime ($filename, $atime, $mtime, $ctime);

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
